properties.description: OWNED_BY attributes gaps to a person and never drags them into a blast radius (crates/reflow2-core/tests/report.rs, 2 tests). CASE 1, gaps_standing_on_ground_you_own_are_attributed_to_you: owning nothing attributes nothing (an unowned design is the ordinary state, not a finding); after taking ownership, the gap on that node appears in gaps_on_owned_ground naming WHICH owned node it stands on and never a node owned by someone else; scoped `clean` goes false, because a gap on your own ground is owed by you as surely as a decision you were asked to settle; and the `next` line says it in words. POSITIVE CONTROL: a second contributor who owns nothing gets an empty list from the identical call — without it, an implementation that attributed every gap to everybody would pass every other assertion. AND A CONSERVATION CHECK: the design-wide gap count is unchanged by scoping, so narrowing never makes the design look smaller. CASE 2, owning_something_does_not_drag_a_person_into_a_blast_radius: propagate_from over an owned node at depth 5 must not reach the Contributor — the exclusion AUTHORED_BY and CLAIMS already carry, asserted rather than assumed for the third of the kind. WHAT IS NOT COVERED, stated rather than left to be found: nothing verifies that ownership is the RIGHT attribution for any given node, because that is a judgement; and no check exists for unowned ground, because none was built.
properties.name: OWNED_BY attributes gaps to a person and never drags them into a blast radius
